identitySignals: Oakland-based organization named 'Tech Exchange' (formerly Oakland Tech Exchange West / OTX), matching the agenda's 'Technology Exchange', Oakland, CA

OUSD's own Home Technology Access page lists Tech Exchange as a community partner for family digital skills and computers, matching OUSD's 'Technology' no-cost services agreement with the Technology Services Department
Tech Exchange's website describes refurbishing computers and distributing them to families and schools, consistent with a no-cost technology agreement
research.notes: Agenda says 'Technology Exchange'; the organization operates as 'Tech Exchange' (formerly Oakland Technology Exchange West). profile.summary: Tech Exchange is an Oakland nonprofit that refurbishes donated computers and gives them to families, schools and community groups in the Bay Area. It also offers digital skills training, help signing up for low-cost home internet, and tech support.
